No controlled content differential was run, and the captured responses contain no reason text.
The three failures are consecutive in this sample; no authoritative rate-limit or session-state code mapping was found.

decision.reason: The third-party observation is not an explanatory QQ code mapping and does not resolve why all three scoped sends were rejected.
